agents.title: Ticket triage
agents.description: Sets priority, category and technician on every new ticket; unclear tickets go to the dispatcher.

params.name: neighbourSimilarityPercent
params.label: Similarity a resolved ticket needs to count as a neighbour (%)

params.name: minNeighbours
params.label: Neighbours needed before history may overrule the model

params.name: reviewWhenUnsure
params.label: Put tickets code cannot settle on the dispatcher's list

agents.title: Time capture
agents.description: Creates time entries from RMM sessions, on-site visits and technicians' notes, without double entries.

params.name: autoConfirmMinutes
params.label: Work read from a note up to this many minutes is entered as confirmed

params.name: maxNoteMinutes
params.label: Longest piece of work accepted from one note

params.name: coveredPercent
params.label: Overlap with an existing entry that counts as the same work (%)

params.name: noteLagMinutes
params.label: How long after the work a note may be written and still describe the same work

params.name: readNotes
params.label: Read technicians' notes with the model

agents.title: Monthly billing
agents.description: Turns confirmed time entries into the monthly invoice by the contract's rules; large invoices wait for approval.

params.name: approvalAboveCents
params.label: Invoices above this total wait for a person (cents)

params.name: approveNoteEntries
params.label: Invoices with time read from notes wait for a person

agents.title: Customer updates
agents.description: Sends the customer one update per status change; drafts that leak internal notes are replaced.

params.name: onAssigned
params.label: Update when a technician takes the ticket

params.name: onWaiting
params.label: Update when the ticket waits for the customer

params.name: onResolved
params.label: Update when the ticket is resolved

params.name: repeatWords
params.label: Words in a row from an internal note that block a draft
